exact_tachyon_rule_source.change_control: Pinned and read-only, source cannot override clinical limits

routes.scope: Research-methods and synthetic outcome summary, not participant reports or real medical data

synthetic_receipt.statement: NO PATIENTS, NO PHYSICAL TIME TRAVEL PROOF, NO HUMAN CONSCIOUSNESS CERTIFICATION

review_contract.awareness_vs_memory: Separate observable immediate task engagement and sensory encoding from delayed episodic retrieval; neither directly measures conscious subjective qualia.
review_contract.order_vs_recall: Preserved item identity does not imply preserved event order and vice versa.
review_contract.no_identity_claim: The system cannot infer that only one consciousness exists.
review_contract.no_timelessness_claim: Reports of no felt time do not prove consciousness exists outside spacetime.
review_contract.no_alzheimer_diagnosis: Alzheimer's is a heterogeneous clinical condition; synthetic task profiles are never evidence of an individual's disease.
review_contract.external_study_required: Ethics approval, consent, clinical ground-truth provenance, matched age/attention/sensory/language confound control, independent preregistration

required_evidence_for_live_communication: Independent explicit approvals + human consent + private channel + signed typed provenance. Not granted here.
